title: Chilli mussels with tomatoes
summary: Chilli mussels with tomatoes is a mexican dinner built around mussels and chopped tomatoes, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Chilli mussels with tomatoes. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add mussels and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and chopped tomatoes.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until garlic is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Chilli mussels with tomatoes before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Chilli mussels with tomatoes.  Serve with the rice, simmered in salted water until tender.
